main_text.head: JOHANNES LEUSDEN

head.i: Dominis Studiosis, Sacro Ministerio Dicatis, Salutem.

main_text.p: OUm editio secunda Compendii Dogmatici D. ANDREÆ ESSENII, Collegæ Conjunctissimi, nescio quo fato, curæ meæ sit commissa, (quam curam ob pietatem in Collegam, libenter mihi imponi passus sum) incidit in mentem circa finem operis: Annon consultum esset huic Editioni addere illas disputationes, quas anno 1645. & 1646. Clariss. D. Johannes Hoornbeek, olim Præceptor venerandus, & postea Collega intimus in hac Academia conscripsit. Fuit intima amicitia inter utrumque Collegam; Fuit eadem intentio in gloria divina promovenda, & eundem modum eandemque Methodum observabant in tuenda causa Dei & Ecclesiæ; Eandem Theologiam profitebantur; Eandem etiam Methodum concionandi, quæ per Excellentiam diu ULTRAJECTINA vocata est, docebant, & juventuti Theologiæ dicatæ privatim & publice instillabant. Ut ergo Domini Studiosi horum duorum magnorum Virorum Theologiam Theoreticam & simul Methodum Ultrajectinam concionės formandi, utramque puram & immaculatam haberent, judicavi consultum hunc utrumque Theologum conjungere; præcipuè hoc tempore cum illa Methodus à nonnullis jam invertatur, permutetur, & pro genuina Ultrajectina

page.notes: The woodcut initial is read as "O" for "Um" with the first letter shown as a decorated capital; the first word is printed "Um" with the initial letter in the woodcut. Doubtful readings: "concionės" (likely concionandi as printed "concionandi"), "immaculatam" line-end with a printer's mark. Show-through and a faint stamp at the bottom right are omitted.
